data.one_liner: Reusable UI component library for Flutter with theme-aware components and built-in animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of customizable UI components, inputs, overlays, navigation elements, and animations. It supports both light and dark modes and is designed for building mobile and desktop applications.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that needs a cohesive set of UI components like buttons, inputs, and bottom sheets.
You want built-in support for light and dark themes with customizable colors and typography.
avoid_when: You require an extensive enterprise design system with hundreds of specialized components beyond standard mobile controls.
You prefer using standard Material or Cupertino widgets without a custom design wrapper.
strengths: Includes a wide variety of ready-to-use components ranging from buttons and inputs to overlays and animations.
Supports light and dark mode out of the box with extensive color and typography customization.
weaknesses: Tied to a specific design style tailored for Coconut Vault/Wallet.
Limited documentation outside of the basic README and changelog.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the library.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Material UI if you want standard Google Material Design widgets.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Cupertino UI if you want native iOS-styled widgets.
